title: Quinn Ewers: We all want to play, but we all want what's best for the Dolphins

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Quinn Ewers: We all want to play, but we all want what's best for the Dolphins
sources.description: When the Dolphins moved on from Tua Tagovailoa during the offseason, it briefly appeared second-year quarterback Quinn Ewers might have a chance to start in 2026.
